## IIndexDef.unique property

Enforce uniqueness on this index.

**Signature:**

```typescript
unique?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

`true` → SQL `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX`<!-- -->: a write whose index value is already owned by a different primary key throws [LmdbError](./lmdb.lmdberror.md) and rolls back. `false` (default) → SQL `CREATE INDEX` (duplicates allowed).
